offering_description.value: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. arranges insurance for businesses, public entities and individuals, and reinsurance for insurers. It advises employers on employee benefits and provides outsourced claims administration and risk management. Its brokers place coverage with carriers, and its specialist teams manage claims and advise clients on controlling losses.

primary_services.value: insurance brokerage; reinsurance brokerage; employee benefits consulting; outsourced claims administration; risk management consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: Businesses, insurers, reinsurers, self-insured employers and nonprofits; B2G: Government agencies, municipalities and public school districts; B2C: Individuals and households seeking personal insurance

end_markets.value: commercial insurance; employee benefits; reinsurance; self-insured claims management; personal insurance

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: Commissions on insurance and reinsurance placements and fees for managing insurance programs; service fees: Fees for brokerage, employee benefits consulting, outsourced claims administration and risk management
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Sources carrier coverage for businesses, public entities and households, and reinsurance capacity for insurers; service provider: Uses employer benefits, claims and loss data to advise clients and administer claims for employers and insurers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, continental Europe, Latin America, Asia and Oceania

specialization.value: related lines: Retail and wholesale insurance brokerage, reinsurance brokerage, employee benefits consulting, claims administration and risk management

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Client-facing brokers, benefits consultants and claims teams serving businesses, public entities and insurers; agents / brokers: Independent retail agents and brokers that place clients’ coverage through Gallagher’s wholesale brokerage

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Insurance intermediary and claims administrator licensing by U.S. state insurance departments, with U.K. brokerage overseen by the FCA
